clips.title: The story
paras: At Brill, Magistrate Sevren receives a warning from the eastern frontier. Deathguard Linnea sends word that the Lich King's mindless servants still test the Forsaken borders.

East of Tirisfal Glades, the road reaches the blighted ruins of the Western Plaguelands, where the Scourge holds sway. The Forsaken built the Bulwark to keep the undead from entering their homeland. Deathguard Linnea watches from a waystation behind the line, gathering reports from the eastern gate. She sends messengers west along the King's Road to Brill before enemy infiltrators can exploit gaps in the defenses.

In Brill, Magistrate Sevren hears that Scourge scouts are finding paths around or through the frontline. Each creeping ghoul and mindless skeleton recalls the Forsaken's enslavement, broken when Lordaeron fell. Sevren vows that no matter how ceaseless the Lich King's assault, the free undead will not surrender their new autonomy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.
But we will not give in. He will not take us again!
